title: The world opens beyond the sanctuary
prompt:

Keep existing identity and persistent damage. Each frame must show the requested intermediate action clearly, not skip to its result.
Input images: Image 1: original character/environment/style reference. Image 2: adjacent story/world continuity reference. Image 3: adjacent story/world continuity reference.
Specific next story moment: Final majestic wide frame. SAME shaman now fully seated relaxed on same west terrace stone edge in left foreground with same amber lantern and pines, legs hanging safely. Huge breathtaking fantasy vista occupying most frame: cloud sea curling around floating ancient stone sanctuaries, thousand-foot waterfalls, towering moonlit jagged mountain ridge with subtle colossal bear/ram carved geological silhouettes, teal aurora arcs, warm distant lantern civilizations, one moon reflected in rivers far below. Rich layered detail beautiful epic gritty painterly realism, not generic scattered islands. Four spirit colors barely glimmer around hero's resting hands/mantle. No text.
